title: Bespoke Saints English — Complete New Testament Reading Draft
source_policy: Inherited NA28 provisional base retained. UBS6/GNT6 migration and relevant ECM/apparatus work remain pending.
authorship: Inherited Saints English book drafts with the six GT-003 proposals and one further John 1:30 proposal. All 7,943 units are not claimed as newly translated in this task.
scope: All 27 NT books and all 260 chapters from the identified repository snapshot. Counts are stored reading units, not a claim of identical versification across editions.
fresh_review_scope: John 1:1–18: 252 Greek token alignments in the earlier pilot
Romans 3:21–31 and James 2:14–26: focused running-text comparison
Philemon, 2 John, 3 John, Jude: focused running-text comparison of all verses
remaining: Full word-by-word evidence for the remainder of the NT
Relevant apparatus, UBS6/GNT6 and ECM comparison
Editorial acceptance and verified website publication

book_inventory.inherited_source_status: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
